text: Mechi kati ya Harbour City na Seabrook Town ilikuwa ya kusisimua sana dakika za mwisho. Harbour City waliongoza 2-0, lakini Seabrook Town walipata upepeteshaji mzuri na ushindi kwa kufunga mabao 4 katika kipindi cha pili [#1104] [#1448] [#1882] [#1906]. Kian Romano alifunga mabao mawili hata kwenye dakika za nyongeza, akifanya Seabrook Town waibuke na ushindi mkubwa [#1882] [#1906]. Marek Barros wa Harbour City alitupia nguvu akiwa na bao moja, ria mbili za pasi na kuzuia mpira mara 9, kitu kilichoonyesha ni mchezaji muhimu kwa timu yake [#975]. Seabrook Town walikuwa na nafasi nyingi zaidi za kufunga (xG 3.48 — maana walikuwa na nafasi ya kufunga zaidi ya mara 3 kuliko Harbour City waliopata 1.0) na walifanya mashambulizi zaidi mechi nzima. Kwa hivi, walitumia mbinu ya kushambulia kwa haraka na kupiga mipira migumu, na kubadilisha mkakati wakati mechi ilikuwa inaisha kuwapeleka kwa ushindi.

trace.output: Brief: full-match recap for fan audience in sw

- Seabrook Town won 4-2 despite trailing 2-0, scoring 4 goals in the second half [#1104, #1448, #1882, #1906].
- Marek Barros was pivotal for Harbour City with 1 goal, 2 assists, 9 interceptions, and a 9.8 rating [#975].
- Kian Romano scored twice in stoppage time to complete Seabrook Town’s comeback [#1882, #1906].
- Seabrook Town had a higher expected goals (3.48 vs. 1.0) and more shots (22 vs. 10) over the match [team_stats].
- Harbour City received a red card at 43' (Joon Whitfield) which likely influenced the match dynamics [#871].

- Seabrook Town won critical balls via quick regains and pressing from midfielders (e.g., Tariq Marlowe’s immediate goal after a regain, with no passes preceding it) showing effective pressing triggering rapid transitions [1103,1104].
- Harbour City’s style of patient short passing with a 4-2-3-1 formation is reflected in their long build-up to the first goal: 17 passes over 56.7 seconds involving multiple players to open play a through ball goal, indicating methodical possession play [904,905].
- Seabrook Town’s 3-4-3 formation with a wide crossing style is visible in their second goal where Tariq Marlowe’s through-pass to Callum Varga ended a 15.6s buildup from a regain, using width and quick vertical passing to penetrate [1447,1448].
- Late in the match, Seabrook Town changed tactics to a higher press and more direct play, increasing pressing intensity from 0.66 to 0.84 and directness from 0.42 to 0.57, enabling them to capitalize on counter-attack opportunities—including Kian Romano’s 90+2’ goal from a 6.7s counter with a quick through ball—emphasizing their adaptive strategy to overturn the deficit [1361,1881,1882].
- Harbour City’s tactical shift late—pressing higher and more direct—was reactionary to the conceding of goals, but their previous low PPDA (7.6) and fewer box touches (42 over the match) compared to Seabrook Town’s (57) show they were less effective maintaining pressure and penetration [team_stats].
